findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty-string results when applying the fallback
findings.body: When `profile.name` is empty or whitespace-only, `trim()` returns `""`. The previous `??` expression preserved that result, while the new `||` expression returns `"Anonymous"`. This changes the exported function’s observable behavior and can break consumers relying on the existing empty-string result.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty-string results instead of applying a truthiness fallback
findings.body:
For `{ name: "" }` or whitespace-only names, `trim()` produces `""`; the new `||` returns `"Anonymous"` whereas the previous `??` returned `""`. This breaks the existing exported function’s observable contract and tests or consumers relying on empty output.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
